review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that advertising brings some positive economical advantages. However, some others believed that it make people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have by its negative social effect. Personally, I think there are strong cases to be made for both side of the argument.

Some people admittedly, one might argue that advertising can bring undeniable economic benefits. This is predicated on the assumption that with creative contents and appealing visual effects, which stimulate consumer demand.

E-commerce platforms such as Shopee or Lazada do in Vietnam and rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. To address this issue, several feasible measures from the

advertising has negative social consequences. This means that constantly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards, or luxury possessions accordingly foster dissatisfaction among viewers. For instance, young people may often feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook. It can be lead to frustration when they cannot afford them. This leads advertising which promote materialistic value and a money-driven culture in the long run.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that both view have their advantages. Advertising which contribute to social dissatisfaction but play a crucial role in economic development.

Bài còn nhiều câu rời, lỗi động từ sau modal và danh từ số nhiều. Em cần nghiêm túc viết lại theo đúng bốn đoạn, nối đủ demand → production → jobs/tax → economy trước khi sang Body 2.

paragraphs: It is argued that advertising brings positive economic advantages. However, others believe that it makes people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have through its negative social effects. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand. This increased demand encourages production, creates employment opportunities and generates greater state revenue through taxation. For example, e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting both their sales and the digital retail sector. Furthermore, advertising directly creates work in marketing, media and design.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. Advertisements constantly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards and luxury possessions, which may foster dissatisfaction among viewers. For instance, young people may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok and Facebook. When they cannot afford them, they may experience frustration. Repeated exposure to these messages may therefore promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
In conclusion, both views have merit. Advertising contributes to production, employment and economic development, while its idealised messages may also increase social dissatisfaction.

Gộp hai phần Body 1 thành một đoạn và hoàn thiện chuỗi kinh tế trước ví dụ Shopee/Lazada.

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: there is an opinion that students who have the best academic results should be rewarded while a different opinion show that rewarding students who show thriving is also important.

From my perspective, admittedly, students who have good score in class should be rewarded such as scholarships, money and more.... If Student have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges, so this may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, and lead to propel towards overall academic gains. Rewards for best students are very suitable and some people have the same opinion like that, it was a part of competition was seen in almost every aspect of life and where only the best individuals are rewarded. From hard and significant competition such as national entrance exam or international degrees, students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which may enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, I also agree with opinion show that student should improve significantly in study process. For example, only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, which cause others to think that their effort is futile, because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals and are prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, lead to gradually lose the incentive to study. If they show their improvement, rewards for them are fully deserved. It may encourage all student to be diligent in their studies and helps students to understand that they need to constantly by improve themselves, which irrespective of how well they have been or are performing, so the constant desire to outdo themselves more than competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that giving rewards to best student and student having improvement was very promising, it can raise study spirit and help them practice themselves.

completion.comment: Em đã viết đủ mở bài, hai thân bài và kết luận.

review.overall: Em viết đủ mở bài, hai thân bài và kết luận, có đủ bốn nhánh chính của dàn bài. Em còn đưa ví dụ học bổng và kỳ thi để cụ thể hóa ý thưởng thành tích, nhưng ví dụ kỳ thi chưa chỉ rõ phần thưởng học đường liên quan thế nào. Lỗi câu xuất hiện nhiều: 'opinion show', 'If Student have', 'constantly by improve themselves' và 'which irrespective' cho thấy em ghép cụm theo ý mà chưa kiểm tra chủ ngữ–động từ. Em cần viết lại toàn bài cẩn thận, giải thích từng lỗi rồi đối chiếu bản sửa, nhất là hai câu chủ đề và các câu kết quả. Body 1 dùng “If” để vào điều kiện công sức nhưng chưa báo lý do đầu, rồi gộp lý do cạnh tranh với câu nhận xét chung. Body 2 gọi cơ chế chỉ thưởng ít em là “For example” dù đó là lý do tổng quát, và chuyển sang lợi ích tiến bộ bằng điều kiện chưa rõ chủ thể.

paragraphs: There is an opinion that students who have the best academic results should be rewarded, while a different opinion shows that rewarding students who make progress is also important. I believe both groups deserve rewards.

Admittedly, students with the best academic results should be rewarded with scholarships or monetary prizes that recognize their hard work. Initially, if students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges, and this may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, thereby improving overall academic results. Rewards for the best students are suitable, and some people support this view of rewarding high achievers. Furthermore, this kind of competition is seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. In competitive settings such as national entrance exams, students can practise coping with academic pressure and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which may enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, I agree that students who make progress should also be rewarded. To begin with, if only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, this can cause others to think that their effort is futile, as they can not surpass those outstanding individuals. They may then feel overwhelmed and disheartened, causing them to gradually lose the incentive to study. Furthermore, if students show improvement, rewards for them are fully deserved. It may encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. As a result, the constant desire to outdo themselves may benefit them more than the determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that giving rewards to the best students and students who make progress can strengthen students' motivation to study and help them keep improving.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: In some major regions in the world, parents doesn't not sent their children to school and choose to teach themselve at home. I strongly believe that both ways of learning offer unique negative and positive effects depending on many reasons.

Some people advocate with studying at home, which allows parents can save money, they may do not feel anxious about school fees. Home educated children is a new studying program for every children in the school, most of their benefits is less likely to experience bullying and peer pressure. Moreover, it can not cause emotional and mental problems. The parent, who teachs them at home by themselves, so they can tailor their curriculum and pedagogical approaches to best suit their young ones and their approaches are often not the case in traditional schooling because of the large class size. This approach can have many advantages, but there are many negative effects deep inside.

This educational approach which is not actually save money as we thinking, parents need to pay a large amount of money for lab equipment and tutors. In addition, one parent need to be cut off for catering for their child's need, be these academic or personal. paragraphs: In some major regions in the world, parents do not send their children to school and choose to teach them at home. I strongly believe that, although both forms of learning have positive and negative effects, the drawbacks of homeschooling outweigh its benefits.

Some supporters of homeschooling argue that it benefits families. First, parents may save money if they do not have to pay school fees. Second, children educated at home may be less likely to experience bullying and peer pressure, which can cause emotional and mental problems. Moreover, parents who teach their children themselves can tailor their curriculum and pedagogical approaches to best suit their young ones. This degree of tailoring is often unavailable in traditional schools with large classes.

However, these apparent advantages have important limits. First, homeschooling may not actually save money as parents may have to pay for laboratory equipment and tutors. One parent may also reduce paid work to meet the child's academic and personal needs. In addition, most parents are not well-versed in every school subject and may struggle to explain concepts to children, which can ultimately lead to academic problems. Finally, even social problems that children may face at school, such as school violence, bullying or having romantic feelings for others, can help them develop social skills when they learn to handle them. Parents should prepare children for these experiences and for social and workplace situations in the future.
In conclusion, while homeschooling may have some benefits, its financial, academic and social drawbacks are more significant. Parents should think long and hard before making a decision.
